method: raw 672-byte candidates gathered at the selection routine entry/exit (ACU-RE-0042) decoded with the offsets in tools/parkour_geometry.py; joined to MeshShape collision decoded by tools/world_collision.py (ACU-RE-0050; primitives not decoded)
row_note: one row per distinct (action_type, source, target) at 1 cm; positions in world metres (Z up, ACU-RE-0047 frame); normal = candidate +0x40 xy; profile = classify_profile at profile_offset_m along +/-normal; edge_* = nearest decoded triangle edge to the target (class per edge_class); fan_* = horizontal ray hit distance from source + height toward the target (null = no hit within fan_length_m); run = index into runs
